title: Matthew Bible Quiz - Chapter 21
description: Ten questions on Matthew 21: the entry into Jerusalem, the temple cleared out, the withered fig tree, and two parables about a vineyard.

questions.text: What did Jesus send two disciples to find in the village opposite them?
questions.explanation: He told them they would immediately find a donkey tied, and a colt with her, which they were to untie and bring to him.

answers.text: A room prepared for the Passover
A boat ready at the shore
A lamb without blemish
A donkey tied, and a colt with her

questions.text: What did the multitudes keep shouting as he went?
questions.explanation: The multitudes in front of him and those who followed kept shouting Hosanna to the son of David, and that blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.

answers.text: Peace to the city of Jerusalem
Hosanna to the son of David
Glory to the house of the prophets
Behold, the Kingdom has come

questions.text: What did the multitudes answer when all the city asked who this was?
questions.explanation: The multitudes said that this is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.

answers.text: The prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee
A teacher sent from the temple
Elijah, who was to come
A stranger from beyond the Jordan

questions.text: What did Jesus do when he entered into the temple of God?
questions.explanation: He drove out all those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers' tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

answers.text: He read aloud from the scroll of the prophets
He called all the children to himself
He drove out those who sold and bought there
He sat down and taught the chief priests

questions.text: What did Jesus say they had made the house of prayer?
questions.explanation: He said it is written that his house shall be called a house of prayer, but that they had made it a den of robbers.

answers.text: A marketplace of the nations
A den of robbers
A seat for the money changers
A house left desolate

questions.text: What happened to the fig tree by the road?
questions.explanation: He found nothing on it but leaves and said that no fruit should come from it forever, and immediately the fig tree withered away.

answers.text: It was cut down by the disciples
It bore fruit out of season
Its leaves became tender again
It immediately withered away

questions.text: What question did Jesus ask the chief priests and elders in return when they asked by what authority he acted?
questions.explanation: He said he would ask them one question, and asked where the baptism of John was from, from heaven or from men.

answers.text: Where the baptism of John was from
Who had sent them into the temple courts
Whose image was on the tax money
Which commandment in the law is greatest

questions.text: In the parable of the two sons, which one did the will of his father?
questions.explanation: The first son said he would not go, but afterward changed his mind and went, and they answered that this was the one who did his father's will.

answers.text: Neither of the two sons did it
The second son, who said he was going
The first son, who refused and then went
Both of the sons did it alike

questions.text: What did the farmers do to the servants sent to receive the fruit of the vineyard?
questions.explanation: The farmers took his servants and beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

answers.text: They beat one, killed another, and stoned another
They sent them back with the fruit
They locked them in the tower
They led them out of the country

questions.text: What did Jesus say had happened to the stone which the builders rejected?
questions.explanation: He asked whether they had never read that the stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner, and that this was from the Lord.

answers.text: It was buried under the vineyard
It was made the head of the corner
It was carried to another country
It was broken to pieces by the builders
